programme.desc: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

programme.title: House of Dracula
programme.desc: This monster movie focuses on the iconic vampire, Count Dracula (John Carradine), and Lawrence Talbot (Lon Chaney), better known as the Wolf Man. Both beings of the night are tired of their supernatural afflictions, so they seek out Dr. Franz Edelmann (Onslow Stevens) for cures for their respective curses. While trying to aid the imposing creatures, Edelmann himself develops a transformative condition, adding to the many ghouls lurking around the foreboding landscape.

programme.title: House of Frankenstein
programme.desc: After escaping from prison, the evil Dr. Niemann (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked assistant, Daniel (J. Carrol Naish), plot their revenge against those who imprisoned them. For this, they recruit the powerful Wolf Man (Lon Chaney), Frankenstein's monster (Glenn Strange) and even Dracula himself (John Carradine). Niemann pursues those who wrong him, sending each monster out to do his dirty work. But his control on the monsters is weak at best and may prove to be his downfall.

programme.title: House of Horrors

programme.title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
programme.desc: While on a boating trip, Scott Carey (Grant Williams) is exposed to a radioactive cloud. Nothing seems amiss at first, but several months later Scott realizes that he's shrunk in height by several inches. He sees a doctor, who admits that he's baffled. As Scott continues to shrink, decreasing to three feet tall, he becomes bitter, and lashes out at his wife, Louise (Randy Stuart). He begins to fear a cure will never be found -- since even as he becomes a national sensation, he's still shrinking.

programme.title: The Invisible Man Returns
programme.desc: Wrongly accused of murdering his brother, Geoffrey Radcliffe (Vincent Price) is found guilty and sentenced to die. But when sympathetic Dr. Griffin (John Sutton) injects him with a serum that renders him invisible, Radcliffe is able to escape and search for the real culprit. With Inspector Sampson (Cecil Kellaway) of Scotland Yard hot on his trail, Radcliffe begins to suspect that a recent hire in his family's mining company might have the answers he seeks.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Global Business-Asian Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI.\n#SummerDavos2026.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: The Datong Motorcycle Diaries
programme.desc: In this Episode, we explore dragon walls in Datong, the City of Dragon Walls, to create a new tourist trail. The host then rides a motorcycle along Datong’s Great Wall, presenting local culture and scenic spots along the way.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Life in the Cloud
programme.desc: The second episode faithfully records what Tianran sees and feels during the backpacking tour in Danba County, Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province. The perseverance, sincerity and hospitality of the people in Xizang leave a profound impression on the travelers visiting this land.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film \"Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon\".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Life in the Cloud
programme.desc: The second episode faithfully records what Tianran sees and feels during the backpacking tour in Danba County, Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province. The perseverance, sincerity and hospitality of the people in Xizang leave a profound impression on the travelers visiting this land.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film \"Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon\".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: The Datong Motorcycle Diaries
programme.desc: In this Episode, we explore dragon walls in Datong, the City of Dragon Walls, to create a new tourist trail. The host then rides a motorcycle along Datong’s Great Wall, presenting local culture and scenic spots along the way.

programme.title: The Pulse
programme.desc: “The Pulse” features musicians performing amidst Guizhou’s stunning natural scenery, bringing to life a harmonious blend of music and landscape.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to \"eat porridge at night\.

programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. In this episode of China Popcast, we tell you which maps to use, how to pay for things, offer advice on how to book tickets for major attractions, share information on China's current travel visa policies and more. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the \"dos and don'ts.\.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: \"Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.\nThough he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China.\.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Nature’s Bounty
programme.desc: In this episode, we start from hiking up volcanoes in Datong. There is a large volcanic cluster with over 30 cones. Then we come to the Hanging Temple – a 1,500-year-old monastery clutching at a cliff of Mount Hengshan. Join us for an adrenaline-pumping adventure.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.title: Wild Wonders Ep.4
programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique \"rock rhyme\" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: The Dynasty of Oracle Bones Ep.3
programme.desc: Over 3000 years ago, inscriptions were made into the bones of oxen and the undersides of turtle shells for the purpose of divination. Broken down into six comprehensive episodes, this series will enlighten you on the Shang Dynasty when they first appeared, as well as their role in the formation of Chinese writing.

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: Dance of Heroes
programme.desc: In this episode, our host “Uncle Hanzi” travels to Chaonan in Shantou to explore the story of a family devoted to the tradition of Yingge dance. Centered around inheritor Hong Shaohua, the story unfolds through his father’s dedication, his daughter’s passion, and his apprentices’ enthusiasm—showcasing how this centuries-old folk art continues to thrive in the modern world.

programme.title: Treasures and Masks Ep.1
programme.desc: A fantastical encounter lies at the heart of this documentary: a meeting between the bronze figures of Sanxingdui and the mask of the great Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamun. ‘Treasures and Masks’ represents a cutting-edge bridging of ancient Chinese and Egyptian civilizations that has to be seen to be believed.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, Michael Symon, his wife Liz, and Liv Annacone cook Big Rigs rigatoni with spicy Italian sausage and vodka sauce in their front yard. Michael demonstrates his "cheater sauce" approach using pre-seasoned sausage, tomato paste, cream, and vodka that comes together in under 30 minutes without needing a knife. The hosts discuss pasta cooking techniques, the importance of finishing pasta in sauce rather than plating separately, proper seasoning of pasta water, and using quality ingredients like whole Parmigiano-Reggiano. They pair the dish with Lambrusco, an Italian sparkling red wine, exploring its versatility with various cuisines and its ability to cut through rich, spicy flavors.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: In this episode of Chewed Up, hosts Clinton Kelly, Carla Hall, and Michael Symon explore the world of peanut butter through a blind taste test of six popular brands, discussing texture, flavor, and baking applications. They identify standout options across smooth, chunky, and nostalgic categories, then demonstrate two versatile peanut butter recipes: a quick Asian-inspired spicy peanut sauce made with soy sauce, sesame oil, rice wine vinegar, and chili crisp served over udon noodles, and an elegant dessert of pitted dates stuffed with peanut butter, drizzled with dark chocolate, and finished with flaked sea salt. Both recipes highlight peanut butter's versatility as a protein-rich ingredient for quick meals, snacks, and desserts.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: In this episode of Simply Symons, Michael Symon grills single-bone pork chops over hot coals and pairs them with a flavorful broth-based sauce of sautéed banana peppers, sweet red peppers, garlic, red onion, chili flakes, Dijon mustard, and herbs. Liz Symon demonstrates how to make a bourbon maple lemonade cocktail with fresh lemon juice and maple simple syrup, ideal for summer entertaining. Co-host Liv Annacone joins the banter as the hosts discuss seasoning techniques, grill setup, and the importance of honest communication in relationships while preparing and finishing this vibrant, quick-cooking American-Italian dish.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, hosts Michael and Liz Symon welcome Liv Annacone to their Venice bay home where they celebrate summer clamming season. Michael prepares a classic steamed clam dish featuring pancetta, garlic, shallots, chili flakes, and white wine, served with grilled sourdough bread rubbed with garlic and ripe tomato. Liz creates a French gimlet cocktail using vodka, fresh lime juice, and elderflower liqueur instead of traditional simple syrup. The hosts discuss clamming techniques, bread storage debate, herb preparation, and garlic preferences while encouraging Liv to expand her seafood palate with the briny, flavorful dish.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, Michael Symon makes a hearty frittata using leftover roasted potatoes, fresh spinach, feta cheese, shallots, and garlic, seasoned with rosemary and cooked in a cast iron skillet over a grill. Meanwhile, Liz Symon prepares an indulgent chocolate-orange brunch cocktail featuring bourbon, coffee liqueur, Grand Marnier, and cold brew coffee, topped with homemade whipped cream infused with vanilla and orange bitters. The episode explores egg quality and sourcing, frittata versatility as a dish for any meal, and creative topping options. Liv Annacone joins the conversation about college memories and various accompaniments. The frittata serves as a practical solution for using refrigerator leftovers and entertaining groups.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Simply Symons hosts an upscale backyard tailgate featuring two main components: Michael's beer-poached bratwurst with kimchi, served on buttered and grilled hard rolls with pop mustard and optional Kewpie mayo, and Liz's inventive bourbon sour cocktail made with sage-infused bourbon, Benedictine, brown sugar simple syrup, lemon juice, lemon curd, and egg whites shaken in a mason jar. The hosts discuss bread storage methods, the classification of hot dogs as sandwiches, and bratwurst preparation techniques including splitting the sausage for better presentation. Liv joins in tasting both dishes, initially skeptical of kimchi but warming to the combination with Kewpie mayo and the bourbon sour despite typically avoiding bourbon.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: On Simply Symons, Michael Symon, Liz Symon, and Liv Annacone prepare a summer feast featuring crispy panko chicken cutlets cooked in cast iron and served over bitter radicchio greens, fresh basil, and parsley with a light garlic-shallot vinaigrette. The team discusses cooking techniques including the FEB breading method, anchovy options, and proper chicken temperature. Liz creates an elderflower rosé spritz using frozen Harry's berries as ice cubes to prevent dilution. The dish comes together quickly and elegantly, demonstrating how simple ingredients and proper technique create restaurant-quality results at home.

programme.title: Simply Symons
programme.desc: Michael Symon, Liz Symon, and Liv Annacone explore two iconic dishes with creative twists. Michael demonstrates his take on the New York bodega classic chopped cheese—ground beef mixed with caramelized onions, melted provolone, and pepperoncini on a hoagie roll with Kewpie mayo. He explains the technique of creating a chopped smash burger texture and offers tips for cooking it indoors or outdoors. Meanwhile, Liz prepares a kid-friendly cherry float by making homemade cherry syrup from frozen cherries, lemon juice, and sugar, then serving it over vanilla ice cream with optional alcohol additions like amaretto or bourbon. The hosts discuss ingredient variations, cooking methods, and how these simple, budget-friendly dishes are perfect for summer entertaining.

programme.desc: Dinner Time Live: The Recipes - Oyakodon Mortadella Sandwich: Chris Ying cooks a Japanese dish called Oyakodon that he made for his buddy David Chang on a recent episode of Dinner Time Live. Oyakodon translates to “parent and child bowl” and refers to the main ingredients: chicken (the parent) and egg (the child). Chicken thighs and sliced onions are simmered in seasoned dashi, then covered in egg, which forms a custard-y blanket to be served over rice. programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Journey back in time to uncover Boone's historic roots and savor its vibrant culinary scene. Chef Walter Staib tries his hand at fly-fishing and connects with modern pioneers shaping the region's food culture. Delve into the historic Tatum Cabin, where delightful recipes are prepared, capturing the essence of Boone's heritage.

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib travels to the enchanting Pacific island of New Caledonia and discovers the harmonious fusion of French and indigenous Kanaky culture and the mouthwatering cuisine born from this blend. From a centuries-old Bougna recipe to the French pastry shops that dot the capital city, New Caledonia is a culinary treasure.

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib explores the rich cultural heritage of New York City. From the diverse influences that have shaped the city for centuries, to a visit to a downtown restaurant that embodies its multicultural spirit. At the historic Harriton house, Chef Staib prepares recipes that pay homage to New York's roots.

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Embark on a captivating history of Machias, Maine and the first naval battle of the Revolutionary War. Gain insight into the region's sustainable practices and the symbiotic relationship between the land and sea. Inspired by the local bounty, Chef Staib creates mouthwatering recipes that celebrate this remarkable coastal town.

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib takes a journey Down Under to Sydney, Australia, where he learns of the regenerative techniques Australian Farmers use to create delicious-tasting Beef and support a sustainable future for the planet. Get ready for a sizzling adventure that celebrates the flavors of Australia in true "Barbie" style!

programme.title: A Taste of History
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib explores Delaware's pivotal role in American history while savoring mouthwatering dishes like Spicy Corn Relish, Stewed Codfish, and Macaroons. Discover how Delaware's small but significant contributions helped shape American culture and politics, from its early Dutch and Swedish settlements to its crucial involvement in the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Every region of Greece has its own unique character and cuisine, and today Diane visits Nemea and Argos, home to some of Greece's most famous wines and dishes. Together with a village cook, she learns to make a homemade local pasta dish and a cheesy skillet pie. Back in the kitchen, she prepares an easy sauteed spinach and orange recipe, braised pork with cabbage, and cookies made with olive oil.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: At a tavern, Diane is enjoying a typical summer meal: mezedes and retsina. Diane follows the last resin tapper in Attica to the Kouvara pine forest to see how the resin that gives retsina its flavor is extracted, and delves into the history of this wine. Back in the kitchen, Diane uses retsina in her recipes and also prepares recipes that pair well with this Greek classic.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: In Greece, they say you can learn to cook, but you're born to grill. Cooking over fire is one of the most ancient ways to enjoy a whole variety of meats, fish, even vegetables. In this episode, Diane visits one of the best-known Greek grill chefs to learn the secrets of cooking over fire. We will see him butchering and Diane will talk about the difference between Greek and US cuts of meat.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: In this episode, Diane visits a local fisherman and fish taverna to learn the secrets of sustainable fish cookery. She discovers some of the local fish and seafood that thrive as well as those that are endangered. She makes kakavia. Back in her kitchen, she cooks up a sea of treats, all environmentally sound, sharing with practices we can all abide by in order to preserve our natural bounty.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: In a tour of Athens that stretches from a walk with Diane through the modern market to the Ancient Agora with Dr. John Camp. This episode explores the history of this ancient cuisine, making it delightfully relevant to our needs and tastes today. Back in the kitchen, Diane prepares an ancient feast for modern cooks, based on ingredients that have been part of this diet for thousands of years.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Killer Barbecue – Hold the Meat You don’t need a degree in barbecue to know that vegetables have hit the grill big time. Veggies for hardcore carnivores who crave killer accompaniments to their meats, for health-conscious grillers, and for everyone who delights in the smokiness and supernatural sweetness live fire imparts to plant and dairy foods.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Charm City ‘Que: Baltimore, the town where I grew up, boasts plenty of awesome foods for grilling. Pit beef was born here. In the seafood department you find a sweet white-fleshed fish the rest of the world calls striped bass and Baltimoreans know as rockfish. And no Charm City meal would be complete without chocolate top cookies.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Barbecue on a Budget: A lot of American barbecue began with inexpensive meat cuts, like spareribs, beef shoulder, and pork belly. With the economic insecurities brought on by COVID- 9, we’re all feeling the pinch, and budget grilling has taken on new urgency. Besides, why should Kobe beef and tomahawk steaks get all the love? This is barbecue on a budget.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Sustainable Seafood: Pollution. Overfishing. Abusive labor practices. There’s a lot of negative news coming out about the seafood industry lately, and much of it breaks your heart. Today’s show celebrates seafood we can eat because it’s fished in a way that’s humane and environmentally sound. Activists call it sustainable seafood. I call it three great reasons for firing up your grill.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Social Distance Tailgating: From its humble origins on the back of a buckboard wagon to today’s high-octane outdoor foodie extravaganzas, tailgating continues to enthrall—make that obsess—American sports fans. This episode is our our annual celebration of tailgating with a global twist. The socializing may be distant this year—all the more reason to up your game at the grill.

programme.title: Doolittle's Raiders: A Final Toast
programme.desc: The bottle of 1896 Hennessy Cognac was uncorked in front of hundreds of people. The surviving World War II veterans from one of historys greatest military missions were about to raise their silver goblets one last time ending a decades long tradition. It was time for the veterans to hold this final toast. They could wait no longer. Their numbers had dwindled to just a few. Many of the names of the 80 flyers who took part in the April 18, 1942 raid on Japan may not be familiar to most, but collectively they will always be known in history as the Doolittle Tokyo Raiders. Long ago these American flyers, aboard 16 B-25 bombers, had accomplished a daring mission that changed the morale of an entire nation. The aviators, led by famed commander Lt. Col. James Harold Doolittle, had taken the fight directly to the enemy for the first time in the war and delivered retribution for Japans sneak attack on Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941.

programme.title: Dad's Secret War: France 1944
programme.desc: Narrated by actor Kevin Bacon, Dad’s Secret War: France 1944 focuses on two top-secret World War II organizations – the OSS (Office of Strategic Services) and the British SOE (Special Operations Executive), American and British organizations responsible for silent, unseen, highly classified missions of critical importance to defeating the Nazis. The documentary shares the riveting, true story of an American who joined the British SOE and was parachuted into France with a small team just after D-Day to organize the French Resistance into a cohesive army. The mission was to stop Germany's most feared troops from reaching Normandy in the days after the D-Day landings of June 6, 1944.

programme.title: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 1968, one of the largest audiences in television history tuned in to an extraordinary sight: a live telecast of the moon's surface as seen from Apollo 8, the first manned space flight to leave Earth's gravitational pull and orbit the moon. The historic journey captivated people around the world.As this documentary reveals, however, the mission's success was far from assured. The Apollo 8 astronauts had just four months to prepare for the risky lunar orbit, and catastrophic failure would have brought a halt to America's goal of putting a man on the moon before the end of the decade.This film recounts the flight many consider to be NASA's most daring and important. Interviews with Apollo 8 astronauts, their wives, mission control staff, and journalists take viewers inside the high-stakes space race of the late 1960s to reveal how a bold decision by NASA administrators put a struggling Apollo program back on track and allowed America to reach the moon before the Soviets.

programme.title: Uncle Jack: The Manhattan Project and Beyond
programme.desc: The Manhattan Project was an enormous undertaking that required the efforts of many of the world's most brilliant intellectuals. Hundreds of physicists, mathematicians, and engineers were needed to design, build, and test the world's first atomic weapon and the Unites States government did everything in its power to lure these individuals to the Manhattan Project. Documentary includes: Interviews with Scientists conducted by the World War II Foundation Interviews with World War II Historians, Interviews with WWII veterans Interviews with those who worked with John Gray in the world of Atomic Energy, Interviews with authors who have written extensively about the Manhattan Project, Interviews with people from the world of academia. This film is personal: One of those assigned to the project was my uncle John Edmund Gray, a University of Rhode Island graduate with a brilliant mind.Tim Gray

programme.title: Survivors of Malmedy: December 1944
programme.desc: SURVIVORS OF MALMEDY: DECEMBER 1944 tells the story of the World War II massacre of 84 American soldiers in Belgium during the opening days of the famous Battle of the Bulge.On December 17, 1944, after a short battle, more than 130 American GIs were taken prisoner just outside the Belgian town of Malmedy and herded into a field by an infamous German SS division led by one of the Nazi's most brutal commanders. The unarmed American prisoners were gunned down. Those still alive after the initial shooting in the brutal cold were killed by SS soldiers ordered into the field to execute any Americans still breathing. Some American soldiers played dead. Some ran. Some escaped to nearby houses. In the end, more than 50 Americans did escape the infamous Malmedy Massacre. Today, just a handful of soldiers remain.Weaving interviews with the few remaining survivors of the massacre with archival footage, and drone video shot in the Malmedy area and in the field where the infamous event occurred, the emotional and powerful SURVIVORS OF MALMEDY chronicles what became known as the largest single mass murder of American troops in World War II.

programme.title: The Tuskegee Airmen: Return to Ramitelli
programme.desc: THE TUSKEGEE AIRMEN: RETURN TO RAMITELLI tells the story of a legendary United States Air Force squadron comprised entirely of Black soldiers. Until 1941, Black soldiers in the U.S. military were considered unfit for service and were limited to positions as cooks and stewards. However, that all changed when the United States Department of War authorized the creation of an all-Black fighter unit known as the Tuskegee Airmen. The squadrons record of success would heavily contribute to the desegregation of the U.S. military only seven years after its formation.In this documentary, veteran Tuskegee Airmen return to visit the site of their operations in Ramitelli Italy. We experience their legacy through World War II-era footage, animated reenactments, and interviews with Tuskegee veterans and historians.

programme.title: Rick Steves' Europe: A Symphonic Journey
programme.desc: Join Rick Steves and the Cincinnati Pops Orchestra on a spectacular musical journey through Europe in RICK STEVES' EUROPE: A SYMPHONIC JOURNEY. This unique, hour-long special shot by CET Cincinnati blends powerful Romantic-era anthems from composers like Strauss, Grieg, and Verdi with breathtaking visuals and Rick's cultural insights. Experience Europe's history, the passion for freedom, and the spirit of unity across borders. Perfect for lovers of music, history, and travel.

programme.title: Karl & Jasmine

programme.title: Bevor jemand geht, kommt jemand rein I Entscheidung 12 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Bevor heute jemand das Big Brother-Haus verlassen muss, wird heute jemand in das Haus hineingehen. Verona Feldbusch wird die Bewohner:innen überraschen und kommt nicht mit leeren Händen: als Nikolaus verkleidet, überbringt sie den Kandidat:innen Weihnachtsgeschenke. Die Bewohner:innen dürfen sich auf einen weiteren Star freuen: Wladimir Klitschko. Passend zu seinem Beruf bringt er einen Boxautomaten mit, an dem die Bewohner:innen zeigen können, wie viel Kraft sie haben. Außerdem ist Domian zu Gast, der ein wahrer Big Brother-Faan ist und seine Meinung zu den Kandidat:innen abgibt. Natürlich darf Musik nicht fehlen, weswegen Marianne Rosenberg ebenfalls zu Gast ist.

programme.title: Wer hat das beste Outfit an? I Tag 86 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Die Aufteilung der Wochenaufgabe führt mal wieder zu einem Konflikt. Linda scheint mit der Aufteilung nicht einverstanden zu sein und gibt das auch klar zum Ausdruck. Doch diese Art gefällt Harry ganz und gar nicht! Alle Big Brother-Kandidat:innen haben sicherlich ihre eigenen Beweggründe, weswegen sie in das Big Brother-Haus eingezogen sind. Alex ist der Meinung, dass die Person lüge, die es nur wegen der Erfahrung mache. Die Big Brother-Bewohner:innen schmeißen sich heute richtig in Schale. Na ja, die anderen mehr, die anderen weniger. Ob schick oder sportlich: Jeder Stil ist heute dabei.

programme.title: Wie soll das Maskottchen heißen? I Tag 87 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Die Big Brother-Bewohner:innen haben die Aufgabe, sich drei Namensvorschläge für das Big Brother-Maskottchen zu überlegen. Frank fällt dabei direkt der Name Biggi ein. Doch Ebru hat einen besseren Namensvorschlag: Faleha. Oder wird es noch Freddy? Alida und Ebru lassen heute ihre ersten Beziehungen Revue passieren. Dabei fällt ihnen auf, wenn blind sie damals vor Liebe gewesen sein müssen. Alidas Ex lies sie weinend draußen im Regen stehen und öffnete nicht die Tür und trotzdem blieb sie bei ihm. Die Big Brother-Bewohner:innen widmen sich heute der Frage, welches Festmahl sie an Heilig Abend essen möchten. Was harmlos anfängt, führt jedoch wieder zu einem Streit.

programme.title: Ebru und Alex tauschen die Rollen I Tag 88 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Seitdem Alex in das Big Brother-Haus eingezogen ist, hat sich einiges verändert. Die Bewohner:innen sitzen längst nicht mehr nur auf dem Sofa, sondern treiben auch Sport. Angeführt von Alex, machen sie draußen vor dem Big Brother-Haus einige Übungen. Ebru und Alida unterhalten sich darüber, wie viel Pech sie mit Essen haben. Und damit soll nicht der Geschmack des Essens gemeint sein, sondern dass sich ab und zu Haare in dem von ihnen bestellten Essen befinden. Heute tauschen Alex und Ebru die Rollen. Alex gibt alles, um wie Ebru auszusehen. Dafür setzt er eine schwarze Perücke, die Ebrus Haar sehr ähnelt. Natürlich adaptiert er auch ihre Redeart. Ebru gibt natürlich auch Vollgas, um wie Alex zu sein.

programme.title: Nur noch Streit im Haus I Tag 89 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Die Big Brother-Bewohner:innen sind gerade dabei, neue Szenen für das Puppentheater zu erfinden, doch schon bricht der nächste Streit aus. Natürlich zwischen niemand Geringerem als Linda und Harry. Harry ist der Meinung, dass das nicht bis zum Ende gut gehen wird und noch etwas passieren wird. Im Statement erklärt er, dass auch die Motivation der Kandidat:innen nachlasse. Grund dafür sei seiner Meinung nach der Streit zwischen manchen Personen.

programme.title: Zwischen Drama und Freude I Tag 90 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Im Haus brodelt es: Harry fühlt sich durch das selbstgeschriebene Marionettenstück angegriffen, während Alex und Ebru beim Üben für die Wochenaufgabe großen Spaß haben. Die Spannung steigt, als die Gruppe die Aufgabe erfolgreich meistert. Doch zwischen Alida und Ebru bleibt es angespannt – Ebru entschuldigt sich, und die Situation entspannt sich.

programme.title: Linda bricht in Tränen aus... I Tag 91 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Es wird weihnachtlich bei Big Brother: Ein Blick auf die exklusive Weihnachts-CD eröffnet den Tag. Die Tagesaufgabe fordert die Bewohner heraus: Weihnachtsgrüße schreiben und eigene Fotos für die Karten schießen. Beim Vorstellen der Karten wird Linda emotional. Es sind nur noch zwei Wochen im Haus, und die Gruppe macht sich bereits Gedanken über das Leben danach.

programme.title: Linda und Alex wollen freiwillig auf die Nominierungsliste? I Entscheidung 13 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Dass Big Brother-Bewohner:innen freiwillig auf der Nominierungsliste stehen wollen, ist wohl nicht alltäglich. Doch Linda und Alex wollen das tatsächlich. Ob ihr "Wunsch" wohl in Erfüllung geht? Heute sind Frauke Ludowig und Guildo Horn zu Gast. Frauke Ludowig verrät, wie die Stars und Sternchen drauf sind und welche die meisten Starallüren haben. Außerdem ist Jürgen zu Gast und das nicht alleine! Mit dabei ist seine Tochter, mit der er einen Song performt. Das frische gebackene Big Brother-Pärchen Daniela und Karim statten der Show nochmals einen Besuch ab und verraten, wie die Suche nach der gemeinsamen Wohnung läuft.

programme.title: Der dritte Advent im Haus! I Tag 93 Staffel 2
programme.desc: Neue Woche, neue Herausforderung! Diesmal dreht sich alles um Weihnachten: Basteln und Schauspielkunst sind gefragt. Nach einem ausgiebigen Mittagsschlaf wird über die großen Fragen diskutiert – was sagt Intelligenz wirklich aus? Der dritte Advent bringt einen festlichen Reim, und Alex stellt eine gewagte Frage: Glaubst du an außerirdische Wesen? Er schon. Doch wie steht der Rest der Gruppe dazu?

programme.title: Affen-Alarm: Beklaut im Paradies?!
programme.desc: Familie Geiss macht Urlaub auf Pulau Pangkor! Doch plötzlich ertönt ein lauter Schrei! Eine diebische Affenbande hat das Urlaubsdomizil entdeckt! Die Räubermannschaft schnappt sich alles, was nicht niet- und nagelfest ist. (S5 E16)

programme.title: Singapur extrem: Todesstrafe und Rikscha-Wahnsinn!
programme.desc: Die Geissens treffen sich in Singapur mit Tourguide Suzy. Zuerst soll die Metropole auf einer Bootsrundfahrt erkundet werden. Schnell kommt es zu einem äußerst heiklen Thema: Singapurs Gesetze und... die Todesstrafe! (S5 E17)

programme.title: Speedboot-Abzocke auf Barbados?!
programme.desc: Die Geissens verbringen einige Tage auf Barbados, doch statt Ruhe will Robert sofort Action. Beim geplanten Speedboot-Trip läuft vieles anders als erwartet. Seit über zehn Jahren zeigt RTLZWEI ihr Leben zwischen Luxusalltag und exklusiven Events. (S6 E02)

programme.title: Überraschung: Robert Geiss kauft heimlich ein Boot!
programme.desc: Es muss ein Boot her! Und das am besten sofort! Robert Geiss weiß auch schon ganz genau, wo er eins bekommt. Also auf zum Bootsladen. Doch Carmen Geiss traut ihren Augen kaum... wieso steht auf einem der Boote bereits Roberts Name? (S6 E03)

programme.title: Bootsdrama und heiße Cheerleader?!
programme.desc: tress pur! Robert und Carmen Geiss machen mit ihren Kindern und dem neuen Boot eine Spritztour. Doch plötzlich passiert es... Robert fährt auf eine Sandbank! Um sie herum nur Felsen und flaches Wasser. (S6 E04)

programme.title: Horror-Trip nach St. Barth!
programme.desc: Auch in Florida ist das Wetter schließlich manchmal schlecht – und so etwas kommt bei den Geissens gar nicht in die Tüte! Daher verlassen Carmen und Robert Miami in Richtung Karibik. (S6 E05)

programme.title: Romantik in der Karibik: Carmen Geiss schwebt auf
programme.desc: Die Geissens finden in der Karibik eine einsame Insel. Carmen Geiss überlegt kurzerhand, einfach mit der Yacht abzuhauen... Aber dann kommt alles anders - denn Robert hat eine Überraschung für sie! Carmen schwebt sofort auf Wolke 7. (S6 E06)

programme.title: Chaos pur: Reinhold Geiss bringt alle auf die Palme!
programme.desc: Robert und sein Vater Reinhold Geiss waren mit den Kindern "angeln". Leider ohne Erfolg. Die schnelle Lösung: ein Fisch vom Fischmarkt. Doch Carmen Geiss kann man nicht so leicht täuschen... (S6 E08)

programme.title: Auf den Spuren von Jennifer Lopez und Enrique
programme.desc: Die Geissens treffen sich heute mit einem Kapitän, der ihnen das Gebiet rund um Miami zeigt. Doch Carmen Geiss' Stimmung ist direkt zu Beginn schon auf dem Tiefpunkt. Zum Glück ist für Ablenkung gesorgt: Ist das etwa die Villa von Jennifer Lopez? (S6 E09)

programme.title: Auf Wolke 7: Robert Geiss übertrifft sich selbst!
programme.desc: Familie Geiss verbringt die Weihnachtszeit in New York! Zuerst steht natürlich Shoppen bei Macy's auf dem Programm. Im Anschluss hat Robert Geiss noch etwas ganz Besonderes organisiert: einen Helikopterflug über die Lichter der Stadt. (S6 E10)

programme.title: Absolut wild: Reinhold Geiss riskiert sein Leben!
programme.desc: Familie Geiss erkundet den Everglades-Nationalpark in Florida. Doch dort wimmelt es nur so von wilden Alligatoren! Die möchten natürlich auch gefüttert werden! (S6 E11)

programme.title: WOW! Carmen Geiss lässt heiße Poolbilder machen...
programme.desc: Carmen Geiss hat eine ganz besondere Überraschung geplant! Und dafür macht sie sich ausnahmsweise sogar die Haare nass! Unsere Lieblingsmillionärin möchte heiße Pool-Bilder für ihren Göttergatten Robert Geiss schießen lassen. (S6 E12)

programme.title: Die Geissens
programme.desc: Die Geissens besuchen den Freizeitpark WonderWorks in Orlando. Erst testen sie einen Hurrikan-Simulator, dann geht es zum Indoor-Sky-Diving. Während die Kinder vorlegen, wagt Carmen den Sprung in den Windkanal. (S6 E14)

programme.title: Scharfes Fotoshooting: Carmen Geiss posiert mit
programme.desc: Heute steht das große Roberto-Geissini-Shooting an - und Robert Geiss hat diesmal richtig dick aufgetragen: bunte Harleys, heiße Models und eine brandneue Kollektion. (S6 E15)

programme.title: Inflagranti erwischt?!
programme.desc: Das gibt Ärger. Die Kinder und Robert haben Carmen Geiss' Wagen "verschönert". Noch bevor Robert Geiss die Situation retten kann, kommt sie plötzlich um die Ecke. Zum Glück hat sie kaum Zeit, sauer zu werden - denn es geht direkt ins Tonstudio. (S6 E16)

programme.title: Mega-Fail beim Poker Run in Miami!
programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss wurden zum Speedboot-Event Poker Run in Miami eingeladen. Die Mission: Mit ihrer Donzi von Spot zu Spot fahren, an jeder Station eine Spielkarte sammeln und am Ende mit dem besten Pokerblatt gewinnen. (S6 E17)

programme.title: Die Geissens
programme.desc: Die Geissens starten eine abenteuerliche Fahrt mit der Donzi. Damit alles gut geht, haben sie einen erfahrenen Kapitän mit an Bord, denn überall lauern Sandbänke. Und dann passiert das Unvermeidbare: Robert und Carmen Geiss sitzen plötzlich fest! (S6 E18)

programme.title: Horror im Keller: Carmen Geiss ist plötzlich
programme.desc: Robert Geiss macht ordentlich Dampf und schickt Carmen Geiss in den Keller, um die Koffer zu holen. Überall warten Klamottenberge darauf, verstaut zu werden. Aber wo bleibt Carmen? (S6 E19)

programme.title: Nichts geht mehr! Totalschaden bei Geissens'
programme.desc: Nach der Rückkehr aus Miami ist es in Monaco eisig kalt und das totale Chaos bricht aus! In der Tiefgarage steht sie kurz vorm Nervenzusammenbruch - kein einziges der heißgeliebten Luxusautos will anspringen! Nur der Maserati läuft… (S6 E20)

programme.title: Hat Robert Geiss heimlich eine Yacht gekauft?
programme.desc: Familie Geiss fliegt mit dem Helikopter von St. Tropez nach Monaco – und weiter nach Alicante. Dort wartet schon Robert Geiss' neues Projekt: ein riesiges Luxusboot. Doch auf der Yacht wird geschraubt, gehämmert und Möbel werden verschoben. (S6 E21)

programme.title: Couch über Bord: Carmen Geiss flippt aus!
programme.desc: Eigentlich wollten Carmen und Robert Geiss in Alicante die Renovierungsfortschritte auf ihrer neuen Yacht inspizieren. Doch plötzlich treibt Carmens Couch einfach im Hafen! Während Robert das Ganze gelassen sieht, ist Carmen kurz vorm Explodieren. (S7 E01)

programme.title: Das Neue Zuhause der Geissens
programme.desc: Carmen überbringt den Töchtern die Nachricht, dass sie sich ein neues Apartment gekauft haben. Bei der Begehung sind sie noch etwas voreingenommen, doch als sie erfahren, dass sie an den gesamten Umbauarbeiten teilhaben dürfen, sind sie überzeugt. (S19 E03)

programme.title: Die Tattoo-Intrige
programme.desc: Nach einem kurzen Abstecher zum Harley Davidson Store seilen sich die Frauen der Familie von Robert ab – unter dem Vorwand einer Shoppingtour. Was er noch nicht ahnt ist, dass sie sich ein gemeinsames Mutter-Tochter-Tattoo stechen lassen. (S19 E06)

programme.title: Carmen, die Kampfmaschine
programme.desc: Die Schwestern bekommen eine private Judostunde, um ihre Fähigkeiten im Bereich der Selbstverteidigung auszubauen. Doch womit wohl keiner gerechnet hat: Carmen ein absoluter Vollprofi im Kampfsport! (S19 E10)

programme.title: Trüffeljagd in Kroatien

programme.title: Guy Rejects Girl's New Personality

programme.desc: Underestimated due to autism, Jayden uses his engineering genius to save his school from a major crisis. His mother's "white lie" about a cruel letter gives him the confidence to prove his true worth.

programme.title: A TikTok Prankster Goes Too Far
programme.desc: Frank "the Prankster" records his escalating pranks on classmates for TikTok fame, causing chaos and damage. When his biggest prank targets the principal, he's caught on camera by his victims. This leads to Frank facing consequences, ultimately apologizing, learning that actions have consequences.

programme.title: Problem Child Gets World's Strictest Babysitter
programme.desc: After Sasha hangs a bully from a flagpole, her father hires a strict babysitter to discipline her. Sasha tries to rebel, but eventually learns respect before being sent to live in a tiny house.

programme.title: Two School Pranksters Go Way Too Far
programme.desc: After their mean pranks go too far, pranksters Frank and Jake are forced by their victims to change their ways. They start a viral "kindness prank" channel, proving that humor can be used for good.

programme.title: Genius Boy Is Kicked Out From Party
programme.desc: Competitive mom Brenda bans Jayden from her son's party for being "too good" at everything. After guests boycott her event for Jayden's, the moms realize kids' friendships shouldn't suffer for parent petty rivalries.

programme.title: Kid Steals First Ever PlayStation 6, He Lives to Regret It
programme.desc: Eddy breaks into a store to steal a PS6, but only snags an empty display box. After leaving his backpack behind, he's arrested and loses the real console his mom had already hidden for him.

programme.title: From Cheerleader Rivalry to Respect
programme.desc: Mean girl Samantha, obsessed with perfection, gets a magic cream that turns her beautiful facade hideous. Humiliated and abandoned, she learns a harsh lesson about inner beauty, prompting a transformation that earns her genuine friendships.

programme.title: Influencer Stalked By Fan
programme.desc: A famous influencer's family is terrorized by an obsessed fan. Her husband, initially dismissive, realizes the danger. He bravely confronts the stalker, saving his family and highlighting that true strength lies in unity and protecting loved ones.

programme.title: Millionaire Falls For Homeless Girl
programme.desc: Blackmailed by greedy Demetrius to rob his brother Dominick, homeless Holly discovers Demetrius is the true villain. Dominick outsmarts him, clears Holly's name, and funds her sick mother's treatment.

programme.title: Girl Falls In Love With Fake Boyfriend
programme.desc: After Meredith is scammed of $1M by an AI catfish, she and her friends track the fraudster to New York. They "scam the scammer" to get the money back. Meredith wins as a journalist and finds true love.

programme.title: Toxic Friends Don't Know Friend Is Secretly Famous
programme.desc: After being bullied for his weight and mocked for his dream of stand-up, lawyer Jonah quits his job. Guided by comedian Lauren, he finds success and proves his toxic friends and ex-girlfriend wrong.

programme.title: Toxic Boyfriend Forces Girl to Quit School
programme.desc: Anaya rejects her fiancé Varun and family to pursue surgery over marriage. 20 years later, as a top surgeon, she is asked to save the life of her now-impoverished ex-fiancé. She agrees, proving the worth of her dreams and the power of her success.

programme.title: Billionaire Dates Poor Person for Publicity
programme.desc: Struggling actress Olivia lands a lead role and dates her wealthy costar, Colin, as part of a plan to secure her family's future. She eventually realizes she's falling for his humble bodyguard, Henry, and breaks up with Colin to pursue real love and her dreams.

programme.title: Nerd Goes on a Date with Hot Girl
programme.desc: Felix pays Mac to learn manipulative pickup tactics to win Teresa. Mac's advice fails, but Felix succeeds by being himself. Mac's schemes backfire when his crush rejects him and his car is towed, proving that playing games only gets you played.

programme.title: Op´n Dörp
programme.desc: Noch vor ein paar Jahren drohte Diahren ein Geisterdorf zu werden. Heute erfreut sich das kleine Rundlingsdorf im Wendland vor allem bei den zugezogenen Familien aus der Großstadt großer Beliebtheit. Aus Berlin, Hamburg, Stuttgart und Leipzig zogen sie raus in die Natur. Noch vor zehn Jahren standen viele der alten Bauernhäuser im Dorf leer. Die Höfe waren für ein Leben von der Landwirtschaft zu klein geworden, ein Umzug in die Städte war für viele Alteingesessene der letzte Ausweg. Für die Zugezogenen ist das ein Glück. Mittlerweile leben wieder 60 Menschen in Diahren - 14 davon Kinder.

Hier kämpft eine Aktivistin für die Rückkehr der Wildflüsse, dort suchen Abenteurer nach echtem Gold – und Packziegen begleiten Naturfreunde durch spektakuläre Landschaften.
